# P03c/d synthetic fixtures

`ranking/` contains byte-identical copies of the independently authored selection
vectors v1. Their source baseline is `e1100c56b0e300484f4854a8f44b707e4d469d19`;
the original private pack is `loop/001/selection-vectors/v1`. The separate v2
checker/provenance correction does not change these semantic inputs or literals.

Canonical preimages and `expected-hashes.json` are expected evidence, not output
regenerated by the ranker. The five original A/B/C score vectors are
`[8,16,12]`, `[4,6,8]`, `[0,4,8]`, `[8,4,0]`, `[8,12,4]`.

All people, recipes, evidence statements, category tags and purchase estimates
are synthetic. Pins bind supplied bytes; neither fixtures nor native construction
prove outside-world truth or production admission. Pure-core checks do not prove
store completeness, full-food derivation, transaction readiness or account effects.
